Security Integration and Camera Systems

Looking for a reliable security contracting firm with the experience and knowledge to protect your property? Tech Force stands by the quality of its work and provides clients with personalized attention based on their specific needs.

The Reliable Access Control and Camera Installation Company

Protecting Your Property Starts With the Right Partner.

Tech Force can provide you with the information and knowledge to help you procure and install the correct access control and camera system to give your company the level of security it needs. Depending on your budgetary and functionality goals, we will deliver the peace of mind that comes with knowing you're protected.

Whether you have a small project or one requiring larger resources, our team of professionals is up to the task. We work with you from the initial site evaluation through equipment selection, installation, and final testing — so the system you get is the system your facility actually needs.

What We Install

Complete Security Solutions

Access Control Systems

Card readers, keypads, biometric systems, and door controllers that restrict and monitor who enters your facility. From single-door installs to multi-building enterprise systems, Tech Force sizes the solution to your operation.

IP and Analog Camera Systems

Indoor and outdoor camera installation covering parking lots, lobbies, warehouses, and commercial facilities. IP and analog systems, NVR and DVR configurations, and remote viewing setup so you can monitor from anywhere.

Intrusion Detection

Motion sensors, door and window contacts, glass break detectors, and alarm panel installation. Integrated with your camera and access control system for a unified security response when it matters most.

Access Control

Control Who Gets In. Know When They Do.

Protecting your property requires the correct approach. Whether it be protection from outside threats or monitoring employee access, the proper access control system working in tandem with your surveillance system can protect you from liability in many forms.

Tech Force helps you select the right technology for your facility size, budget, and security requirements — then installs it cleanly and trains your team on how to use it.

Key card and fob reader installation
Keypad and PIN-based entry systems
Biometric access control
Door controller and electronic lock wiring
Multi-door and multi-building deployments
Integration with camera and alarm systems

Camera Systems

See Everything. Miss Nothing.

A well-designed camera system doesn't just record — it deters incidents before they happen and provides the documentation you need when they do. Tech Force installs camera systems sized to your facility and budget, from a handful of cameras on a small commercial property to multi-building enterprise deployments.

We handle the full installation: running the cabling, mounting the cameras, configuring the NVR or DVR, and setting up remote viewing so you can monitor your property from any device.
